objective: For the eta=1/100 uniform-strip target, determine the strongest completion-preserving minor-arc estimate available for the exact fixed-window R71 quadratic form, and decide whether it lowers the first open arithmetic edge.

frozen_passport.zero_free_conclusion_if_target_is_proved: Re(rho)<=99/100, with the symmetric lower bound Re(rho)>=1/100
frozen_passport.source: the complete cutoff-independent von Mangoldt field, equivalently the frozen Vaughan tail plus its exact Type-I head; the evaluated-center coordinate is allowed only with its proved X^o(1) endpoint Euler defect, whose induced energy and cross terms are power-below the target
frozen_passport.normalization: n^(-1/2), normalized compact R71 B-spline window, nonnegative translated block weight
frozen_passport.quantifiers: one fixed window family and every sufficiently large translate; no density-one, subsequential, or selected-block replacement
frozen_passport.completion: tail-tail, tail-center, center-tail, and center-center terms remain inside the same quadratic form
frozen_passport.minor_coordinate: first distinguish Mellin frequency difference |u-t| from additive rational/cofactor arcs

candidate_lemma: After multiplying the whole completed field by a larger plateau chi=1 on supp(psi), split the exact two-frequency kernel by |u-t|>Omega. Use Young and Plancherel, and then a compact Gevrey-s block weight, to make that far-difference contribution power-negligible for Omega=K R^s, s>1.
fast_falsifiers: check the Fourier convention and the exact 1/(2pi) Young-Plancherel constant
test whether the hard near/far pieces are positive or even separately energies
retain all three tail-tail, tail-center, and center-center contributions in a finite completed R71 block
compare two admissible plateau extensions chi and record any noncanonical dependence
separate this Mellin-difference split from the primitive reciprocal response and from denominator/determinant major arcs
compare the surviving passport with current primary dispersion and Kloosterman-fraction theorems before claiming novelty or applicability
success_criterion: Either prove an exact completion-preserving far-difference bound with an eta=1/100 exponent ledger, or exhibit a faithful counterexample. In either case identify exactly which near/rational/cofactor sector still carries the target.
stop_rules: do not call a signed hard-cut piece positive
do not allocate the center after taking absolute values
do not sum a conditional cofactor expansion absolutely
do not promote a pointwise reciprocal packet saving to a completed cofactor saving
do not call an endpoint-equivalent localization a proof of a strip
nonclaim: No fixed-power bound, uniform zero-free strip, sharp four-cycle bound, or RH proof is assumed.
